paragraphs: Gordian sells construction cost data, procurement services and facilities assessments to organizations that budget, build and maintain the capital-intensive assets their communities rely on. Its main lines are Job Order Contracting for construction work and assessments with capital planning for existing assets.

RSMeans Data Online gives estimators more than 92,000 unit line items covering equipment, material and labor prices. Company researchers spend over 30,000 hours a year checking that the listed costs are accurate. Pricing is location-specific for over 970 locations across North America. Job Order Contracting replaces traditional procurement with one competitively-awarded contract used for a variety of projects. On the planning side, four Facility Condition Assessment approaches let an organization match the level of detail, speed and support it needs.

The company states that more than 16,000 organizations worldwide rely on it. Buyers include schools, healthcare facilities and government agencies looking to maximize their resources. Gordian reports completing more than $4B in construction volume in 2024.

quote.text: Gordian collects and analyzes more than 1.65 billion gross square feet of facilities data each year
